greet.speaker: Court Wizard Calder
greet.text: The salt-fog carries a foul hum, castaway. The old cairns stir, and ancient wyvern bones upon the beach burn cold under the moon. Walk carefully.

choices.text: Have you seen wyverns in the skies?

study.speaker: Court Wizard Calder
study.text: The ley-currents of this coast. Ancient dragons roosted here before man stacked the first stone of Wrackmouth. Something is waking beneath the earth.

wyverns.speaker: Court Wizard Calder
wyverns.text: Not yet. But the scorched farmsteads upon the Crossholm road did not burn by peasant pitch. The Mayor doubts, but I have read the ash.

grave_omen.speaker: Court Wizard Calder
grave_omen.text: You saw the cracked cairn stone? That hex-rune was etched with brimstone and dragon marrow. Keep your weapon sharp, survivor.

choices.text: The Mayor sent me to investigate.

investigate.speaker: Court Wizard Calder
investigate.text: Carry whatever you unearth to Crossholm. The garrison mages have seen the portents before. Mayor Tolle acts in haste; wisdom lies eastward.
